text:
maria: Heads up — a few customers are hitting SCIM deprovision 403s since we rolled the idp-proxy cookie/headers change last night. Seeing 'external_id decrypt failed' in audit logs. Affected tenants: acme-inc, beta-app, greenstack.

jake: Can you paste a sample request/response and any headers? Are these only 403s or also 401s?

maria: Mostly 403. Sample response from provisioning-service: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"deprovision_failed","detail":"external_id decrypt failed: kms:InvalidCiphertextException"}
```
Request headers include: 
```
Cookie: session=eyJ...; SameSite=None; Secure
X-Forwarded-For: 10.12.45.6
X-IdP-Proxy: idp-proxy-3
```

dena: We rotated the KMS key for scim-extid at 2026-03-20T02:00Z (key version v2). Rotation completed but we only sent cache-flush to most idp-proxy pods; some older pods didn't pick up the new DEK. If a proxy tries to decrypt an envelope encrypted with v2 using cached v1, KMS returns InvalidCiphertext.

ops-jen: Alerting: SCIM 5xx/403 spike at 02:10-03:00 UTC, matches rotation window. Load balancer logs show session affinity TTL spiking for idp-proxy group-3 — sticky session landed on older pod afterwards.

jake: Ah, cookie SameSite change may have changed which requests preserved the idp session when routing through the browser vs API. That mixed routing + partial proxy cache update would explain only a subset of tenants failing.

maria: Example of audit line: 
`audit: tenant=acme-ext action=deprovision result=deny detail="kms:InvalidCiphertextException" proxy=idp-proxy-3`

rod: Can we retroactively re-encrypt the bad external_id envelopes? Or do we need a rolling restart?

dena: Options: 
- Quick: force idp-proxy cache flush / rolling restart for all groups (fast, minimal data risk).
- Medium: requeue failed SCIM jobs after reprovisioning envelopes (backfill consumer will attempt decrypt using current key).
- Risky: rollback KMS rotation (not ideal; rotation already used by other services).

maria: Priorities: 1) Stop live failures (restart proxies). 2) Backfill failed deprovisions for affected tenants. 3) Post-mortem and telemetry changes (key_version in audit).

ops-jen: Starting rolling restart of idp-proxy group-3 now, wave size 3 pods. ETA ~6m/wave.

sso-bot: deploy-bot: restart idp-proxy group-3 initiated by ops-jen.

jake: Also adding immediate logging change: log attempted key_version and envelope header on decrypt failure so we can map failing envelopes to key versions. I'll ship a 10-line hotfix and config flag to enable verbose decrypt logging for 24h.

dena: I'll coordinate a targeted requeue for tenants acme-inc/beta-app/greenstack once restarts finish. We should also mark affected audit records so CS can notify customers with a timestamp and remediation status.

ops-jen: Wave 1 completed. Error rate for deprovision down from 6%->2.1%. Wave 2 starting.

deploy-bot: rolling restart progress: wave-1 OK, wave-2 in progress.

ops-jen: All waves complete. SCIM 403s for the three tenants dropped to baseline (0.4%). Backfill job queued for 3 tenants (job id: bf-20260320-11).

maria: Nice. Follow-ups: 
• Add key_version to SCIM audit record and to envelope metadata.
• Add a KMS-rotation canary that checks idp-proxy cache flush across all AZs before marking rotation done.
• Add a one-click 'force re-encrypt' tool for provisioning backfill.

rod: Also add a monitor for 'decrypt InvalidCiphertext' rate with high alert severity during rotations.

dena: Filed SEC-452: "KMS rotation -> idp-proxy cache flush failures: add key_version, canary, backfill tool, decrypt metrics".

maria: Thanks everyone. Will update incident log and ping CS with tenant-level notes. :white_check_mark: :thumbsup:

rod: thx — closing loop after post-mortem.
